title: Radiographic Peri‐Implant Bone Changes in Osteoporotic Women Treated With a Ti‐Zr, Bone Level Tapered Implant With a Hydrophilic Surface: A 12‐Month Prospective Case‐Series
authors: Elena C, Nikos M, Iro P, Sara T, Nikolaos D. Radiographic Peri -Implant Bone Changes in Osteoporotic Women Treated With a Ti -Zr, Bone Level Tapered Implant With a Hydrophilic Surface: A 12 -Month Prospective Case-Series. Clin Oral Implants Res. 2025 Oct;36(10):1234-1247.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss collprotect (porcine dermis) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “In this case series, osteoporotic patients treated with single titanium -zirconium implants showed high survival rates, predictable 12 - month implant outcomes, and physiologic peri-implant bone remodelling” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
